title: "Tissue boxplots from DESeq2 normalized counts"
author: "Sulev Koks"

output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
resolve_project_dir <- function() {
  candidates <- c(
    Sys.getenv("WORKSPACE_DIR"),
    Sys.getenv("PROJECT_ROOT"),
    Sys.getenv("PWD"),
    getwd(),
    "."
  )

  for (candidate in candidates) {
    if (nzchar(candidate) && dir.exists(candidate)) {
      return(normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
    }
  }

  for (root in c("/scratch", "/mnt", "/workspace", "/tmp")) {
    if (dir.exists(root)) {
      return(normalizePath(root, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
    }
  }

  normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  cache = TRUE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  echo = TRUE
)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

project_dir <- resolve_project_dir()
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "plots")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_plot_checkpoint <- function(plot_obj, name, dir_path = output_dir) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(dir_path, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    device = "pdf"
  )
  invisible(plot_obj)
}
```

```{r load-data}
if (!exists("dds")) {
  dds_path <- file.path(project_dir, "gdds_all_tissues.rds")
  if (file.exists(dds_path)) {
    dds <- readRDS(dds_path)
  } else {
    stop("No dds object found. Run the DESeq2 notebook first or provide a saved dds object.")
  }
}
```

```{r helper-function}
make_tissue_boxplot <- function(dds, genes, title) {
  norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
  gene_set <- intersect(unique(genes), rownames(norm_counts))
  if (length(gene_set) == 0L) {
    warning("No genes available for: ", title)
    return(NULL)
  }

  expr_mat <- log2(norm_counts[gene_set, ] + 0.5)
  expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(expr_mat))
  expr_df$sample <- rownames(expr_df)

  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(dds))
  meta$sample <- rownames(meta)

  long_df <- meta[, c("sample", "tissue")] %>%
    left_join(expr_df, by = "sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(sample, tissue), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expression")

  p <- ggplot(long_df, aes(tissue, expression, fill = tissue)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = "Tissue",
      y = "Expression (log2 normalized counts + 0.5)",
      fill = "Tissue",
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  p
}
```

```{r plot-generation}
for (name in names(gene_sets)) {
  p <- make_tissue_boxplot(
    dds = dds,
    genes = gene_sets[[name]],
    title = paste("Top", name, "genes")
  )
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    print(p)
    write_plot_checkpoint(p, gsub("_", "-", name))
  }
}
```

This version keeps the same biological intent, but it is easier to rerun headlessly and safer to maintain because the plotting logic is centralized and each figure is saved to an output folder.
